parsed.reason: Description A says metadata is written before the blob, so a failed or interrupted blob write leaves new metadata paired with old bytes. Description B says the mutable default dict `{}` is shared across calls and mutated by setdefault, so content types leak between uploads. These are different root causes (write ordering versus a mutable default argument), even though both touch the metadata lines.
